description: This file contains service functions for managing 'courses' in a database via Supabase, including create, list, retrieve by ID, update, and delete operations, with error normalization.

methods.name: createCourse
methods.description: Inserts a new course record into the 'courses' table, generating a UUID and including the creator's user ID if available.

methods.name: listCourses
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of courses with optional search and status filters, returning data and total count.

methods.name: getCourseById
methods.description: Retrieves a single course record by its ID.

methods.name: updateCourse
methods.description: Updates an existing course record identified by ID with provided payload.

methods.name: deleteCourse
methods.description: Deletes a course record by its ID.

methods.name: normalizeSupabaseError
methods.description: Converts raw Supabase error messages into user-friendly messages, detecting missing table or RLS permission issues.
